risks.title: Cyberattacks and Data Security
risks.score_rationale: The risk is presented first in the Risk Factors section and identified as potentially having a material future impact. The language emphasizes the constantly evolving and increasingly sophisticated nature of cyber threats. Dedicated governance with a CISO, an active Audit Committee, and reporting to the Board at least twice a year reinforce the critical importance of this exposure.

risks.title: Security Incidents and Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The link between data security and reputational risk is implicit but strong, particularly through Board-level exposure and regular escalation protocols. Although not materialized to date, the recurring nature of the topic in quarterly Audit Committee reports indicates high vigilance, critical for IT services.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Economic Risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned implicitly in the risk management context, with concrete effects on operating results. Global economic uncertainty affects customer demand and ordering cycles. Direct impact on cloud and AI transformation projects.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks and Currency Exposure
risks.score_rationale: Accenture is exposed to fluctuations in foreign currencies across its global operations, with hedging in place for major pairs USD/JPY, USD/INR, EUR, GBP, AUD, CHF, PHP, CNY. A 10% change in exchange rates would have impacted the fair value of hedging instruments by $722 million as of August 31, 2025.

risks.title: Leadership Continuity and Key Talent
risks.score_rationale: Executive leadership has undergone significant changes in September 2024 and 2025, with transitions at the regional CEO and strategic leadership levels. Operational continuity is managed by experienced teams, but leadership stability remains an important factor.

risks.title: Contractual Obligations and Asset Impairment Risks
risks.score_rationale: Accenture has commitments of $3 billion for cloud hosting and IT services, of which $1.154 billion is due within 12 months. These obligations are managed and non-cancellable, but represent a mandatory cash outflow.
